input_contract.alphabet: VCF SNV/indel records with genome annotations

score_contract.score_semantics: CADD deleteriousness score, not a sequence-model log-likelihood ratio

provenance.notes: Official CADD-scripts v1.7 release path was audited. The GRCh38 annotation bundle is documented as approximately 300 GB, and the current repository has neither the annotation assets nor a verified license/asset checksum. Deferred by compute/storage and comparator-provenance review; the existing deterministic CADD comparator remains test-only.
